repairs.mechanism: Fixed separately supplied activation authority and whole-universe substitution rejection remain mandatory.
policy-ir-2 waiver-before-baseline program, replay, and overlap control remain mandatory; RR13-02 remains informational.
RT9 retains the v8 crash-reclaim, fencing, and stale-token reducer without weakening.
RT9 retains recursively closed authority records and the product checker exact-digest join.
Binding JSON now declares every record/component/list tag, scalar/order/duplicate/domain rule, and record/commitment golden.
Six distinct VERSIONING-v4 historical roles and refs enter the exact same-capability dependency closure.

canonicalCommitmentGrammar.records: Normative detail is closed by normativePreimageGrammar; this summary is non-substitutive.
canonicalCommitmentGrammar.ordering: deduplicate exact record bytes then sort unsigned bytewise ascending

scalarEncoding.text: NFC-normalized UTF-8 with no BOM; persisted values are non-empty, <=4096 bytes, and exclude U+0000..U+001F and U+007F
scalarEncoding.canonicalUnsignedDecimal: ASCII digits; zero is 0; otherwise no leading zero; schemaVersion is encoded this way

recordRules.omission: required fields MUST occur exactly once; conditional fields obey variant rule; no undeclared field bytes
recordRules.duplicates: duplicate scalar fields and duplicate logical list members are forbidden
recordRules.nestedLists: outer blob occurs once; every item is separately item-tagged; item records are complete record bytes
recordRules.sortedLists: sort complete item record bytes unsigned bytewise ascending before item framing
recordRules.programOrder: PolicyV2.evaluationOrder preserves the declared program order and is not sorted

records.name: BaselineV1
records.variantRule: kind=none forbids baselineRef/matchedMembers; kind=comparison requires both

leaf.preimage: tag || uint64be(record byte length) || record bytes

outer.preimage: recordTag || blobFrame(namespaceTag,namespace) || blobFrame(domainTag,domain ASCII) || blobFrame(merkleRootTag,32-byte root)

commitment.itemSetRule: deduplicate exact record bytes, then sort unsigned bytewise ascending
commitment.digestText: sha256:<64 lowercase hexadecimal digits>; truncation forbidden

preimageGoldens.purpose: Independent implementations can reproduce every nested record byte string and every declared commitment preimage without checker-source tag discovery.

proofObligationsByClaimShape.local-match: typed subject plus at least one retained factRef
proofObligationsByClaimShape.relationship-match: typed relation semantics plus at least one retraceable witness edge and factRef
proofObligationsByClaimShape.aggregate-match: typed exact member-set commitment/count, retained partition, fold and facts
proofObligationsByClaimShape.no-match: typed exact subject-set commitment/count and retained fact partition
proofObligationsByClaimShape.indeterminate: typed resolvable reason; never absorbed into pass
proofObligationsByClaimShape.error: typed resolvable reason; never absorbed into pass

Every direct/transitive reference, including all six exact VERSIONING-v4 historical roles, resolves once in one ProjectId graph; omissions, aliases, mislabels, cycles, injection, and unused objects reject.
requiredUniverse.memberIds exactly equals the sorted activated member set and its commitment.

policySemanticsV2.hostRule: The host seals the core-returned policyOutcome and MUST NOT rederive a different verdict. Independent readers replay these same pure semantics to verify it.
policySemanticsV2.baselineRule: Classify only effective matches remaining after exact waiver suppression; an effective baseline match is advisory.
policySemanticsV2.waiverRule: Validate exact content-addressed waivers, then suppress each targeted current match before any baseline classification.

activationAuthority.trustedInputRule: Only the exact closed opensip-evidence admission envelope is accepted; raw EvaluationAuthoritySealV1, bundle-local authority, boolean verification flags, and producer/caller assertions are rejected.
activationAuthority.timing: EvaluationAuthoritySealV1 is content-addressed and admitted before evaluation; terminal RunId/runSealRef are derived only after semantic EvidenceDigest validation.

authoritySeam.consumerBoundary: validate_bundle(bundle, verifiedAuthorityInput) accepts only VerifiedEvaluationAuthorityInputV1 supplied by opensip-evidence
authoritySeam.requiredPlanProof: opensip-plan recomputes PLAN-ID-V1 from the admitted resolved inputs and emits a verification receipt; caller-supplied PlanId is never authority
authoritySeam.requiredStoreProof: opensip-store resolves resolvedEvaluationAuthoritySealRef in ProjectId scope and proves its exact closed bytes bind sealedActivationManifestRef before evaluation
authoritySeam.evidenceOwner: opensip-evidence admits and supplies the opaque verified envelope only after both owner proofs succeed
authoritySeam.epVerificationLimit: EP4 validates closed shape, authority-seal bytes/ref, identity equality, activation-manifest bytes/ref, C2 commitment join, and receipt custody; EP4 cannot inspect store state or earn trust in the receipts
authoritySeam.failureRule: missing, raw, bundle-local, boolean-only, wrong-owner, cross-ProjectId, terminal-reference-bearing, identity-mismatched, or manifest-mismatched input fails closed
notClaimed: PLAN-ID-V1 was recomputed from real admitted inputs
RUN-ID-V1 or terminal runSealRef was derived

versioningV4RoleJoin.propagationRule: Every role propagates the source reference exact minimum unchanged; no role-specific weakening, strengthening, or alias exists.
